intro: Austin's public sauna scene is made up of drop-in social bathhouses and small sauna gardens, mostly in East Austin, South Lamar and North Loop. Ceremony Spa and Bathe run communal bathhouses with saunas and cold plunges, Sauna House runs a wood-burning Sauna Garden, and Cøntrast offers a walk-in garden sauna with two cold plunges. Prices, hours and session formats change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: Cøntrast (The Garden)
venues.neighborhood: East Austin (Casa de Luz Village East)
venues.address: 1915 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd #101, Austin, TX 78702
venues.drop_in_price: $29 per person for a 60-minute communal Garden session
venues.cold_plunge: Two cold plunges and an outdoor shower (included)
venues.schedule: Sun-Thu 10am-9pm, Fri-Sat 10am-10pm. Walk-ins welcome for the Garden. Bathing suit required.
venues.notes: Communal 'Garden' sauna is described by the venue as a traditional wood sauna; whether it is wood-fired or electric is Unknown. Private suites (infrared sauna, cold plunge, shower) are sold separately at $49 solo / $65 for two.

venues.name: Bathe
venues.drop_in_price: $55 per person for a regular 120-minute Soak Pass; $33 early-bird pass (Mon-Thu, start 8am-12pm); $29 late-night 60-minute pass (9pm-10pm)
venues.session_length: 120 minutes (60 minutes for the late-night pass)
venues.schedule: Open daily 8am-10pm per the venue's website. Book online by time slot. Coworking access included with passes.
venues.notes: Bathhouse garden with saunas, steam, cold plunges and soaking pools. Which saunas are wood-fired or infrared is only partly confirmed on the venue's own pages; ResortPass lists wood-fired, infrared and Finnish saunas. Massage and package add-ons are sold separately.

venues.name: Ceremony Spa (Bathhouse)
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown on the venue's public pages (shown in its online booking flow); a 2024 Do512 guide listed $44 for up to two hours
venues.session_length: Up to about 2 hours per the venue and a 2024 local guide
venues.cold_plunge: Two cold plunges: indoor (usually about 55°F) and outdoor (usually 40-45°F)
venues.schedule: Mon-Fri 10am-11pm, Sat-Sun 8am-11pm. Same-day bookings and walk-ins accepted; availability not guaranteed. Swimsuits required; towels provided.
venues.notes: Communal bathhouse with a 16-person cedar sauna indoors and an 8-person sauna outdoors, plus lounge, tea and showers. Shareable 10-packs never expire; unlimited memberships available. Individual bookings need 3 hours' notice to cancel (late cancels and no-shows charged 50%).

venues.name: Sauna House Austin (Sauna Garden)
venues.address: 1507 W N Loop Blvd, Austin, TX 78756
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown (price shown in the venue's online booking flow)
venues.schedule: Sun 9am-10pm, Mon 4pm-10pm, Tue closed, Wed-Fri 12pm-10pm, Sat 9am-10pm. Co-ed shared space; phone-free; guests 18+, or 14+ with a legal guardian. Card required to hold a booking; cashless.
venues.notes: Interim 'Sauna Garden' concept with wood-burning Finnish saunas, cold plunges and heated lounge benches while a permanent space is built next door. Towels, private changing rooms and patio showers provided; bring a non-sheer swimsuit.
